problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation $T$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -6 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Find $a+b+c,$ given that the matrix form of the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 & a \\ b & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}c \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$
